# optimizelycmp_routing_rule (Resource)

A routing rule, written through the API's bulk settings import (experimental). The import matches by name and never deletes, so the name cannot change (a new name is a new rule) and destroying this resource only stops Terraform managing it. After every write the rule is read back and the apply fails if CMP did not keep what was sent.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "optimizelycmp_routing_rule" "legal" {
  name          = "Legal review requests"
  description   = "Send requests tagged for legal to the legal template"
  template_name = "Article Post"
  watchers      = ["legal@example.com"]

  rules = [
    {
      field_type = "label"
      identifier = "content_pillar"
      operator   = "equal"
      value      = ["Brand"]
    },
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Rule name. Changing it creates a new rule and leaves the old one in CMP.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Description.
- `rules` (Attributes List) Conditions. The API validates them; when tested it accepted field_type dueDate, label and customField, and operator "equal" for label and customField conditions. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--rules))
- `template_name` (String) Name of the template this rule applies. It must name an existing template: the API silently drops an unknown name, and the apply then fails. Unsetting it clears the template.
- `watchers` (Set of String) Email addresses of CMP users who watch work routed by this rule. They must be existing CMP users: the API silently drops any other address, and the apply then fails. CMP also adds a default watcher on its own, and watchers added in CMP outside Terraform are ignored. Watchers cannot be removed through the API as far as tested, so removing one fails at plan time.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The rule name (the API gives routing rules no other identifier).

<a id="nestedatt--rules"></a>
### Nested Schema for `rules`

Required:

- `field_type` (String) dueDate, label or customField.
- `operator` (String) For example equal.
- `value` (List of String) The labels, choices or due date value to compare with.

Optional:

- `custom_field_type` (String) For customField conditions: dropdown, multichoice, multi_select_dropdown or checkbox.
- `identifier` (String) Required for label (the label group) and customField (the field) conditions; must be unset for dueDate.
- `unit` (String) days, weeks, months or years. Required for dueDate and not allowed otherwise.
